overview.title: About the game
overview.description: This is a social game where participants write anonymous comments about each other, guess authors, and earn points. The admin manages the game and decides whether to participate in writing comments.

step1.title: Create or join a game
step1.description: Admin creates a game with a password, others join by ID.

step2.title: Write a comment
step2.description: When you are chosen as the target, other participants write anonymous comments about you.

step3.title: Rate comments
step3.description: Admin shows comments and awards points (0-10) for each.

step4.title: Guess the author
step4.description: Try to guess who wrote each comment about the target.

step5.title: Next round
step5.description: The game continues with a new target until everyone has been a target.

comments.title: Points for comments
comments.description: Admin awards 0-10 points for each comment about you.

target.title: Points for target
target.description: Each participant can give points to the target player (0-10).

guessing.title: Points for guessing
guessing.description: +1 point for each correctly guessed comment author.
